resources.string: A fast, polished SMS app built on your phone\'s native messaging.
DarkX Message sends and receives regular text messages.
Messages travel over your SIM and carrier, like any text.
Your messages stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
Read your conversations any time, even offline.
Allow notifications so new messages reach you right away. You can change this later.
Set DarkX Message as your default messaging app to send, receive, and manage SMS messages. Android allows only one app to manage message storage.
DarkX Message isn\'t your default messaging app yet. Until it is, new messages can\'t be received or managed here.
This device doesn\'t support choosing a default messaging app, so SMS features are unavailable.
DarkX Message is already your default messaging app.
DarkX Message is your default messaging app.
DarkX Message isn\'t your default messaging app. You can choose it later in your phone\'s default app settings.
